title: Monsters
html:
Monsters are also referred to as mobs, which stands for Mobile Objects. They are creatures in dungeons that can be killed for experience and loot. In dungeons, mobs are found in large groups and will attack you as soon as you enter a certain range.

There are several categories of mobs. Listed from weakest to strongest: Fodder, Normal, Champion, Hero, and Boss.

Monsters, like players, can be roughly divided into three main "classes": fighters, rangers and mages. Fighters needs to get close to players to do damage. Rangers and mages are capable of attacking players from a range. Note that ranged and magic monsters will move away from you if you get too close to them: they will always try to maintain a set distance between you and them. Sometimes as they are moving away they will give up their chance to attack, so that they can be "chased."

Most monsters fall into five basic categories. To find the listing for a specific monster, check the Category page for its type.


  • Whiskers are the first type of monsters encountered in Dew Valley Forest and Algernon. They are various sorts of ratlike creatures.
Basic Whisker Types: Whisker, Whisker Blademaster, Whisker Venomspitter, Whisker Shaman, Whisker Berserker, Whisker Blaster
  • Mutants are strange creatures of different sorts, including large lumpy ones and small twisted ones.
Basic Mutant Types: Mutant Hulk, Mutant Puker, Mutant Twins, Mutant Pincer. Mutant Unipsycho, Mutant Spitter, Mutant Wasp, Deviant Hurler, Conscript
  • Fades are actually constructed creatures, including bug sorts, various skeleton like monsters and large floating things.
Basic Fade Types: Fade Lichlord, Fade Banshee, Fade General, Fade Soldier, Fade Devastator!, Fade Hatchling, Dread Mantis, Fade Widow
  • Oroks are the grotesque but humanlike creatures found in many dungeons.
Basic Orok Types: Orok Spawn, Orok Warrior, Orok Mystic, Orok Scout, Orok Juggernaut, Orok Chieftain, Orok Hunter
  • Demonspawn include actual demonic things as well as angels and demi-human beings.
Basic Demonspawn Types: Knight, Angel, Lava Rachnid, Raythe, Oracle, Phantom,Mangler, Shadow Howler, Lava Balrog


There are a couple of other categories for mobs that do not fall into the classes above:


  • Wolves, pups, hounds and wargs get a page of their own.
  • Miscellaneous monsters do not fit any of the categories above.


There are also special pages for Bosses and for Champions and Heroes.
